orchestration_result.final_recommendation: The €300,000 IT hardware requirement will be divided into two lots, each with a value of €150,000. Both lots will be awarded through an open procedure. The sustainability criteria for Lot 1 are energy-efficient equipment with an energy label of A or better, and for Lot 2, recyclable and reusable materials in the product design and packaging.
